summary: Queue new seat starts in memory while host admission is closed

replay.detail: No new claims or database queue are introduced.

schema.detail: The existing runtime-start journal is unchanged.

rules.detail: New agent, exec and PTY seat starts enter a FIFO before launch preparation and durable start admission. Internal gate runners bypass it. Authorized restart and rollout replacement of an originally live seat bypasses with an admitted: replacement diagnostic; stopping phases are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The policy is opt-in and never modifies running sessions.

downtime.detail: No migration or live runtime teardown.

manual.detail: Cancel through existing stop, suspension, declaration or control-intent changes. Queued starts retain no frozen launch credentials.

recovery.detail: Daemon restart loses FIFO order and re-evaluates retained desired intent. Pressure appearing after dispatch does not defer an already admitted start; no backend wait or journal transition is added.
